          Findings and Recommendations
          ----------------------------

Finding 1: Undersized SGA
Impact is .8 active sessions, 64.97% of total activity.
-------------------------------------------------------
The SGA was inadequately sized, causing additional I/O or hard parses.
The value of parameter "sga_target" was "135680 M" during the analysis period.

   Recommendation 1: Database Configuration
   Estimated benefit is .53 active sessions, 42.98% of total activity.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Increase the size of the SGA by setting the parameter "sga_target" to
      144160 M.

   Symptoms That Led to the Finding:
   ---------------------------------
      Wait class "User I/O" was consuming significant database time.
      Impact is .89 active sessions, 72.07% of total activity.


Finding 2: Top Segments by "User I/O" and "Cluster"
Impact is .59 active sessions, 47.98% of total activity.
--------------------------------------------------------
Individual database segments responsible for significant "User I/O" and
"Cluster" waits were found.

   Recommendation 1: Segment Tuning
   Estimated benefit is .51 active sessions, 41.68% of total activity.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Run "Segment Advisor" on TABLE "DBO.COMPROMISOS_PAGOS_GLOBAL" with
      object ID 144860.
      Related Object
         Database object with ID 144860.
   Action
      Investigate application logic involving I/O on TABLE
      "DBO.COMPROMISOS_PAGOS_GLOBAL" with object ID 144860.
      Related Object
         Database object with ID 144860.
   Rationale
      The I/O usage statistics for the object are: 37 full object scans,
      34302287 physical reads, 1 physical writes and 33693314 direct reads.
